pack.name: DM Draconic Path, Synergies & 83 Lesser Boons
pack.author: Dungeon Master

entries.name: Draconic Natural Armor (2 + 1/4 Lvl)
entries.benefit: Natural Armor bonus equal to 2 + 1 per 4 character levels.
entries.description: Grants a scaling Natural Armor bonus of 2 + floor(Character Level / 4).

entries.name: Dragon Breath Weapon (Acid)
entries.benefit: Move Action: 60 ft. Acid Breath deals 4d8 Acid damage (Reflex DC 10 + Level + CON mod half; recharge 1d4+1 rounds).
entries.description: Exhale a 60-foot line of acid as a Move Action (DM Override), dealing 4d8 Acid damage. Reflex save (DC 10 + Level + CON modifier) for half damage. Recharges in 1d4+1 rounds.

entries.name: Draconic Acid Resistance (Lvl x 2)
entries.benefit: Acid Resistance equal to Character Level x 2.
entries.description: Grants Acid Resistance equal to twice your character level.

entries.name: Draconic Toughness (+Lvl HP)
entries.benefit: Gain bonus Hit Points equal to your Character Level.
entries.description: Your draconic resilience grants +1 hit point per character level.

entries.name: Draconic Core (1 hr/day)
entries.benefit: 1 hour/day: Gain Acid Immunity and deal 2x Breath Weapon damage.
entries.description: Once per day for 1 hour, you gain full immunity to Acid and your Breath Weapon deals double damage (x2).

entries.name: Master of Deferment
entries.benefit: Postponed Fate (Immediate, 1/hr): Delay a failed emotion/mind/condition save effect by 3 rounds. Eyes of the Oracle (Immediate, 1/hr): Intervene as a readied action after seeing an enemy action.
entries.description: Postponed Fate (Immediate Action, 1/hour): When you fail a save against emotion control, mind control, or a condition (Blind, Slowed, etc.), delay the effect for 3 rounds. Eyes of the Oracle (1/hour): React to an enemy action as if you had readied an action.

spawnsBuff.name: Postponed Fate (Delayed Condition)
spawnsBuff.note: Failed save effect takes effect when this 3-round countdown expires.

entries.name: Draconic Counter
entries.benefit: Sacrifice a spell: Counterspell as Greater Dispel + Sacrificed spell's Level. If countered, caster takes 5 mental damage for each spell level dispelled this way
entries.description: Sacrifice a spell: Counterspell as Greater Dispel + Sacrificed spell's Level. If countered, caster takes 5 mental damage for each spell level dispelled this way

entries.name: Perfect Casting
entries.benefit: Gain +10 (sacred) to concentration checks for spellcasting. Your Spells are harder to counter or dispel (gain +5 DC vs counter and dispel)
entries.description: Gain +10 (sacred) to concentration checks for spellcasting. Your Spells are harder to counter or dispel (gain +5 DC vs counter and dispel)

entries.name: Rune Affinity
entries.benefit: Gain +10 (sacred) to identify, activate item/rune, use magic device checks
entries.description: Gain +10 (sacred) to identify, activate item/rune, use magic device checks

entries.name: Control Arcane (Synergy: Draconic Counter + Perfect Casting)
entries.source: DM Draconic Path (Draconic Counter + Perfect Casting)
entries.benefit: When counter a spell with draconic counter, instead of counter the spell, you may choose a new target for the spell
entries.description: When counter a spell with draconic counter, instead of counter the spell, you may choose a new target for the spell

entries.name: Devour Rune (Synergy: Draconic Counter + Rune Affinity)
entries.source: DM Draconic Path (Draconic Counter + Rune Affinity)
entries.benefit: Devour a magic item's daily usage & gain that many spell slot back OR Destroy a rune/glyph (d20+10+caster level+cha mod vs DC) if succeed also gain that many spell slot back
entries.description: Devour a magic item's daily usage & gain that many spell slot back OR Destroy a rune/glyph (d20+10+caster level+cha mod vs DC) if succeed also gain that many spell slot back

entries.name: Rune Control (Synergy: Perfect Casting + Rune Affinity)
entries.source: DM Draconic Path (Perfect Casting + Rune Affinity)
entries.benefit: When use a magic item, you use them with half charge OR use full charge and add a metamagic effect that you know on the spell. Spells you cast from items DC is either item's DC+2 OR 10+Level/2+Cha Mod+4 (whichever is higher)
entries.description: When use a magic item, you use them with half charge OR use full charge and add a metamagic effect that you know on the spell. Spells you cast from items DC is either item's DC+2 OR 10+Level/2+Cha Mod+4 (whichever is higher)

entries.name: Absorb Magic
entries.benefit: Immediate Action: +2 Competence save vs targeted spell. If saved, gain 10 Temp HP per spell level (EONT) and inflict Slowed (Ref), Sickened (Fort), or Confused (Will) on caster.
entries.description: Gain +2 competence bonus on saves vs a spell that targets you. If saved, gain 10 temporary HP for each spell level dispelled this way (EONT). Caster of the saved spell gets (EONT): if Reflex spell: Slowed; if Fort spell: Sickened; if Will spell: Confused.

entries.name: Elemental Accustomed
entries.benefit: Full Acid Immunity. In Marsh/Bog/Swamp: ignore difficult terrain, +10 Outdoorsman & Stealth, +3 Natural Armor, and DR 3/-.
entries.description: Gain full immunity to ancestral element (Acid). Ancestral terrain (Marsh, Bog, Swamp) is favored terrain: ignore difficult terrain, gain +10 Outdoorsman and Stealth, +3 Natural Armor, and DR 3/-.

entries.name: Draconic Scales
entries.benefit: Standard Action (1/day for 1 min): Gain DR (Level + floor(Level/4))/magic.
entries.description: Once per day as a Standard Action for 1 minute, gain Damage Reduction equal to Level + Level/4 bypassed by magic.

entries.name: Arcane Shield (Synergy: Absorb Magic + Elemental Accustomed)
entries.benefit: Synergy Unlock: Upgrades Absorb Magic save bonus from +2 to +4 Competence. When saved with Absorb Magic, gain Improved Evasion, Mettle, and +Sacred AC per spell level (EONT).
entries.description: Requires Absorb Magic + Elemental Accustomed. When saved with Absorb Magic, gain Improved Evasion, Mettle, and +AC (Sacred) for each spell level dispelled this way (EONT). Absorb Magic's competence bonus becomes +4 instead of +2.

entries.name: Grand Scales (Synergy: Absorb Magic + Draconic Scales)
entries.benefit: Synergy Unlock: Draconic Scales also grants SR (11 + Level) and Immunity to Critical Hits.
entries.description: Requires Absorb Magic + Draconic Scales. While Draconic Scales is active, also gain Spell Resistance (11 + Character Level) and Immunity to Critical Hits.

entries.name: Elemental Supremacy (Synergy: Draconic Scales + Elemental Accustomed)
entries.benefit: Synergy Unlock: Acid damage heals you (100% absorption). At-Will (Std Action): Acid Aura deals 2d12 + CON mod Acid on touch and heals 1 + CON mod per round.
entries.description: Requires Draconic Scales + Elemental Accustomed. Acid damage heals you. At Will (Standard Action): Cover your body with acid; touch deals 2d12 + CON mod Acid damage, Swarm Resist 10, and you heal 1 + CON mod HP each turn.

entries.name: Possessive Dragon
entries.benefit: If a feat, ability, spell or spell like ability effects an item in your possession, you roll a Will save (emotion effect) vs effect DC; if saved your items are not effected
entries.description: If a feat, ability, spell or spell like ability effects an item in your possession, you roll a Will save (emotion effect) vs effect DC; if saved your items are not effected

entries.source: DM Draconic Path (Possessive Dragon + Draconic Affinity)
entries.benefit: If a spell or spell like ability is sourced from an item/scroll/rune (which is not crafted with draconic magic), you defend like you have 21+Level SR against it & if resisted, the source item lost all charge. You gain 10 temp HP for each charge lost this way (max 100) (EONT)
